title: Bit Flag Operations
description: Write a Zig program that demonstrates bit-level operations by setting, clearing, and toggling flags in a permission system.
verificationTest: output.includes('read: true') && output.includes('write: false') && output.includes('exec: true') && output.includes('admin: true')
hints: Zig's `packed struct` allows struct fields to be packed into contiguous bits
Packed structs can have boolean fields that use exactly 1 bit each
Default values can be set in the struct definition with `= false`
